cover.title: Béla Fleck, Edmar Castañeda, Antonio Sánchez Trio
cover.calloutLabel: A note from President and Executive Director
cover.pressQuote: "Béla Fleck has done more to reconceptualize and popularize the banjo than any musician since Earl Scruggs." The New York Times

sections.title: Welcome
sections.quote: Béla Fleck can do things with a banjo nobody thought possible. Alongside harpist Edmar Castañeda—who plays bass, melody, and harmony simultaneously—and drummer Antonio Sánchez, this trio takes you on musical explorations rich with strong melodies, gorgeous harmonies, and sinuous grooves.
body: BÉLA FLECK banjo EDMAR CASTAÑEDA harp ANTONIO SÁNCHEZ drums Turning his instrument into a conduit for creativity, Béla Fleck can do things with a banjo nobody thought possible. Now, serendipity has found him alongside two partners who match him note for note: harpist Edmar Castañeda, who plays bass, melody, and harmony simultaneously, and Antonio Sánchez, a drummer whose rhythm feels like a conversation. As one powerful entity they take you on musical explorations rich with strong melodies, gorgeous harmonies, and sinuous grooves. Audiences leave stunned, delighted, and positively beaming.
